3001UNDERGRADUATE · 3 CREDITS

UCF · CIVIL, ENVIRONMENTAL, AND CONSTRUCTION ENGINEERING

Introduction to
Environmental Engineering

A core undergraduate course introducing environmental engineering practice, the chemistry of environmental systems, and tools for evaluating and designing treatment processes.

What students learn

  • Explore environmental engineering careers, professionalism, and ethics.
  • Apply environmental chemistry to engineering problems.
  • Conduct mass and energy balances for reactors and natural systems, along with chemical and thermodynamic calculations.
  • Use engineering tools to address water and wastewater treatment, solid waste disposal, and air pollution.
